system.description:
Requirements: You must make contact with the Blue Spirit and be accepted as its follower

The enigmatic blue spirit is a creature of secret and forbidden knowledge. Its followers tend to be mages, scholars, and investigators. The spirit's true nature is unknown, but to those who pay homage, it grants blessings in the form of sweet whispers.

  • Select 1 Path Ability with the Blue Spirit trait. You immediately gain that Ability without the associated XP Cost.

  • You have Advantage on checks to perform research. If you would gain Advantage from another source, you have Greater Advantage.
